_comment: Sample Scripted REST provisioner for the Graph Entity Service connector (design §6). The connector-specific settings (objectTypes, pageSizeDefault, byIdLookup, deleteMissingTolerated, apiKeyHeader) travel in customConfiguration as a Groovy ConfigSlurper script and surface to the scripts via configuration.propertyBag. objectTypes is a JSON string. byIdLookup is 'get' (GET /admin/entities/{id}) or 'search' (an EQUALS filter on the ID, decision P21) while GET by ID is unreliable (C1). Authentication (decision P13): the service takes one shared API key, sent raw in the X-API-KEY header. Put the key in 'password', which IDM encrypts on write; leave 'username' empty and 'defaultAuthMethod' NONE so IDM adds no Basic header.
name: graphentity

configurationProperties.password: CHANGE-ME: the service's X-API-KEY value. IDM encrypts it on write.

objectTypes._comment: Populated by the Schema operation on first load (IDM refreshes it when the connector configuration is updated). Leave empty in source control.
